headline: Google patches an exploited Pixel zero-day as CISA sets a deadline
summary: Three outlets report Google's September Pixel security update and the zero-day it fixes. They differ on how firmly the exploitation is stated, from actively exploited to indications of limited targeting. One outlet also reports a three-day CISA patching deadline for federal agencies.
